newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kygnus Sekiyu topper turnaround to start April 4.
newsitem.headline: Kygnus Sekiyu topper turnaround to start April 4.

text.p: Kygnus Sekiyu Seisei said on Monday it planned to close its 70,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) crude distillation unit at its Kawasaki plant for ten days starting April 4 for routine maintenance checks.
Kygnus Sekiyu will also shut its secondary refining facilities -- catalytic reformers and desulphurisation units -- for maintenance work around the same period, a refinery official said.

A catalytic reformer with capacity of 9,333 bpd will be closed from April 1 to April 10, while a second reformer with capacity of 3,000 bpd will be closed from March 26 to April 13, the official said.
A 17,000 bpd gas oil desulphurisation unit will be shut from March 25 to April 15, and a 15,000 bpd kerosene desulphurisation unit will be shut from March 27 to April 13, the official said.
Kygnus Sekiyu Seisei is a fully owned subsidiary of Tonen Corp.
